title: ‘The Valley’ Picks Up Season 3 Filming to Capture Fallout of Jax Taylor Being Spotted With Ex-Wife Brittany Cartwright’s Publicist
summary: The Bravo series had already shot its full season and reunion, but resumed production to document the cast's reaction to the 'Vanderpump Rules' alum being papped looking cozy with Lori Krebs, he and his ex-wife's longtime publicist.
